projects.name: QRStream — Offline Erasure-Coded File Transfer Protocol
projects.tech: Python sidecar + Dart/Flutter + TypeScript | 170 commits, MIT, CI v1.0.1
description: Designed wire-compatible offline protocol: RaptorQ fountain-encode K symbols → cycling QR grid (1×1 to 3×3, V27/V34/V40, 12–30fps, metadata every 32 ticks for late-join) → ZXing-C++ decode → FrameBuffer dedup by ESI → any K of K+repair symbols rebuild + SHA-256 gate; transfer cap 16 MiB.

Implemented Rust codec via flutter_rust_bridge 2.12 FFI (71KB Rust + 27KB C++) with Python verification pipeline, continuous linear tile scaling (nearest-neighbour hard edges, camera-decodable), per-frame CRC-32C + whole-file SHA-256; honest throughput ~46 KB/s (1 MiB ~23s measured) via Playwright headless + virtual camera — docs/PERF.md.

Shipped 3-OS releases: Linux install.sh (SHA256SUMS verified) + RPM, Android APK (stable keystore via GitHub Secrets — fixes INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE), Windows installer (MSVC runtime app-local); 118 Flutter tests; ARCHITECTURE + THREAT-MODEL documented.

projects.name: AgentDock — Visual Builder → Docker-Isolated Agent Runtimes
projects.tech: BUILD & CONQUER 3.0 WINNER (1st Place, 8hr, Altreno Club BMSIT) | TypeScript, Bun, Hono, BullMQ/Redis, FastAPI/Python, Dockerode, React Flow
description: Built React Flow canvas that compiles natural-language agent descriptions into fully self-contained Docker Compose runtimes (API gateway + Redis + FastAPI workers) — no coupling to builder backend; judges stopped rubric to ask to run locally vs single-purpose apps.

Solved container isolation under timer: volume mounts + network routes for dynamically spawned agents to share files / communicate; debugged network routes + volume mounts as timer ran down — achieved reliable isolation where other teams hardcoded single apps.

Engineered orchestration: Hono gateway + BullMQ job queue (Redis), Python FastAPI agent runtime, RAG memory via ChromaDB/offline sentence-transformers (per-agent Git-backed markdown volumes), LLM Gateway (5 providers: OpenAI/Anthropic/Groq/Gemini/Ollama with failover + rate limiting).

projects.name: ZonePilot — Fleet Zone Compliance Engine
projects.tech: Java 25, Spring Boot 3.5, PostgreSQL 16 + PostGIS + pgRouting, Flyway, Docker | 47 commits | Live: zonepilot-snowy.vercel.app
description: Architected Spring Boot 3 fleet brain: pgRouting directed Dijkstra on Bangalore OSM (blr_2po_4pgr, 1000× zone penalty, 5-attempt recursive compliance + wait-state via Google Routes), Flyway migrations, Docker Compose + partitioned vehicle_position_log (monthly) + 5 GIST spatial indexes.

Implemented atomic breach detection inside PostgreSQL trigger (trg_detect_zone_breach AFTER INSERT) — no missed violations on app crash — plus stateful map-matching (30m snap with heading, 50m off-route 2-tick reroute), IST timezone overnight curfew logic, ST_Covers boundary handling.
